items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: We used to play local gigs. I remember playing with Al, I used to play high school dances with him.

ctx.x: How did you land a gig with Al?

Well I used to play with Al Hirt before Al Hirt was Al Hirt, before we all knew of him as being a famous trumpet player. We used to play local gigs. I remember playing with Al, I used to play high school dances with him. We used to play like just regular weekend gigs, I used to play with him. And lo and behold all of a sudden he becomes a famous, real famous guy. Isn’t that something?

There seemed to be a whole style of instrumental music that did well in the 50s and early 60s, like Al and everybody from Ray Conniff and all that kind of instrumental music that, you don’t see that much nowadays.
